options = []
	
	itemLinkNum = len(self.view.custom.lotItemLinks)
	for i, row in enumerate(value):
		if itemLinkNum > 0:
			foundMatch = False
			for link in self.view.custom.lotItemLinks:
				if row['itemPath'].startswith(link):
					foundMatch = True
					break
			
			if not foundMatch: continue
			
		lotStatus = row['lotStateName'] or ''
		if lotStatus != (row['lotStateReasonName'] or lotStatus): lotStatus = "%s (%s)"%(lotStatus, row['lotStateReasonName'])
		
		options.append(
						{
							'label': "%s | %s | %s | %s %s | %s"%(row['lotName'], row['itemName'], row['assetName'], row['lotEventQty'], row['itemUnitName'] or '', lotStatus),
							'lotId': row['lotId'],
							'assetId': row['assetId'],
							'itemUnitId': row['itemUnitId'],
							'lotEventQty': row['lotEventQty'],
							'lotName': row['lotName'],
							'itemId': row['itemId'],
							'itemName': row['itemName'],
							'itemPath': row['itemPath'],
							'itemUnitId': row['itemUnitId'],
							'itemUnitName': row['itemUnitName'],
							'lotStateId': row['lotStateId'],
							'lotStateName': row['lotStateName'],
							'lotStateReasonName': row['lotStateReasonName'],
							'lotStateReasonId': row['lotStateReasonId'],
							'value': i
						})

	return options
